content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the inability of the system to handle multiple fields that share the same column name but have different field names. The original implementation used a `Map<String, Field>` to associate column names with fields, which did not allow for multiple fields to be stored under the same column name. The patch modified this to a `Map<String, List<Field>>`, enabling the storage of multiple fields for the same column name, thus resolving the issue.
